title: Ski Resorts Are Saving Last Winter's Snow Under Piles of Sawdust. It Works.
description: In Finland, Switzerland and Canada, the first turns of the season happen on snow that is six months old. Here is how sawdust keeps it alive all summer.
dek: In Finland, Switzerland and Canada, the first turns of the season happen on snow that is six months old.
card_image_alt: A tall pile of stored snow under a thick layer of sawdust in a green alpine meadow
tour_maps_lead: Canmore's stored-snow track sits a short drive from Banff, and all three Banff-area ski areas are in GoSki as full 3D trail maps. So are the US resorts that race to open first every fall.
